correctness.rationale: Das–Nongsiang Proposition 3.4 proves the noncentral centralizer sets give the clique-block decomposition for every finite nonabelian AC-group. For K1 the only zero forcing set is the vertex itself; for K_m with m>=2 a set is zero forcing exactly when it omits at most one vertex, giving x^(m-1)(m+x). Zero forcing on a disjoint union is componentwise, yielding the product and exact minimum-set classification. Minimum rank is additive because graph-pattern matrices are block diagonal: mr(K1)=0 and mr(K_m)=1 for m>=2. Thus mr=|J| and M=Z=N-|J|. Exact exhaustive replay on five directly constructed AC-groups confirms the formulas.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete structural classification across all finite nonabelian AC-groups: every minimum forcing set, the entire polynomial, exact maximum nullity, and exact real minimum rank. Most importantly, the polynomial becomes a complete isomorphism invariant for this natural algebraic graph class and its linear factors recover the centralizer-component sizes. That recognizability statement is mathematically meaningful beyond the routine fact that zero forcing polynomials multiply over components.
